records.title: Gabatarwa
headings: Saurin amsawa a sabis na abokan ciniki
Tsara kanban a gudanar da ayyuka
Layukan saƙonni don sadarwa tsakanin shirye-shirye
Bututun tura manhaja na ci gaba a DevOps
records.text: Muna amfani da ka'idar layi a ayyukanmu don dalilai da yawa: Saurin amsawa a sabis na abokan ciniki Tsara kanban a gudanar da ayyuka Layukan saƙonni don sadarwa tsakanin shirye-shirye Bututun tura manhaja na ci gaba a DevOps Saurin amsawa a sabis na abokan ciniki Misali, muna so mu yi nazarin yadda abokan ciniki ke neman taimakon tallace-tallace da taimakon tallafi, da kuma saurin da muke amsawa. Wasu samfuran da suka dace su ne misali Salesforce, LiveChat, Zendesk. Tsara kanban a gudanar da ayyuka Misali, muna so mu bi diddigin lokutan jagora da lokutan ci gaba yayin da sabon ra'ayin fasali ke bunƙasa daga ƙira zuwa isarwa. Wasu samfuran da suka dace su ne misali Asana, Jira, Microsoft Project. Layukan saƙonni don sadarwa tsakanin shirye-shirye Misali, muna so mu ƙara yawan fitarwa zuwa matuƙa kuma mu rage matsi zuwa ƙarami yayin da wani shiri ke aika buƙatu zuwa wani shirin. Wasu samfuran da suka dace su ne misali RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, ZeroMQ. Bututun tura manhaja na ci gaba a DevOps Misali, muna so mu tabbatar cewa sabar haɗawa ta ci gaba (continuous integration) tana da ƙarfin gwada manhajarmu sannan ta tura ta. Wasu samfuran da suka dace su ne misali Jenkins, Bamboo, Azure DevOps.

records.title: Kalmomin layi
records.text: Kalmomin layi babban batu ne. Wannan sashe yana ƙunshe da wasu kalmominmu da aka saba amfani da su. Don misalai, za mu yi amfani da ra'ayin abokin ciniki da ke jira a layi. Nau'o'in layi da nau'o'in sabis Nau'o'in layi da nau'o'in sabis suna bayyana yadda layi ke zaɓar abubuwan da za a sarrafa. First In First Out (FIFO), wato na farko da ya shigo shi ne na farko da zai fita: a yi wa abokin cinikin da ya fi daɗewa yana jira sabis. Last In First Out (LIFO), wato na ƙarshe da ya shigo shi ne na farko da zai fita: a yi wa abokin cinikin da ya fi ƙarancin lokaci yana jira sabis. Fifiko (Priority): a yi wa abokan ciniki sabis bisa matakin fifikonsu; waɗannan matakan na iya dogara da matsayi, gaggawa, biyan kuɗi, da sauransu. Shortest Job First (SJF), wato aiki mafi gajarta da farko: a yi wa abokin cinikin da ke buƙatar mafi ƙarancin sabis sabis. Longest Job First (LJF), wato aiki mafi tsayi da farko: a yi wa abokin cinikin da ke buƙatar mafi yawan sabis sabis. Shortest Remaining Processing Time (SRPT), wato mafi ƙarancin sauran lokacin sarrafawa: kamar SJF, amma sabon gajeren aiki da ya iso zai iya katse wani aiki mafi tsayi da ake yi masa sabis tuni. Round Robin, wato bi-da-bi: a yi wa kowane abokin ciniki sabis na ɗan gajeren lokaci, sannan a koma ga abokin ciniki na gaba, a maimaita. Time Sharing wato Processor Sharing (PS), raba lokaci: a yi wa kowa sabis a lokaci ɗaya; ana raba ƙarfin sabis daidai a tsakanin duk masu jira. SJF da SRPT suna rage matsakaicin jira, amma suna iya hana dogayen ayyuka sabis har abada, don haka tsarin gaske kan ƙara tsufa (aging) ko iyakokin fifiko.

records.title: Alamomin ka'idar layi
headings: Yawan fitarwa: jimillar yawa, yawan kammalawa, yawan nasara, yawan gazawa, yawan tsallakewa
Lokacin jagora, lokacin mataki, lokacin aiki, lokacin jira
records.text: Ka'idar layi tana amfani da alamomi masu haruffan Girka. Ƙungiyoyinmu suna amfani da wasu shahararrun alamomi; muna kuma ƙara wasu alamomi na musamman da ke taimaka mana a ayyukan manhaja. Alamarmu da ma'anar kowace alama: Alamarmu Ma'ana κ (kappa) adadin abubuwa a cikin tsarin, masu jira tare da waɗanda ake aiki a kansu λ (lambda) yawan isowar abubuwan da ke shiga tsarin μ (mu) yawan sabis wato ƙarfi: saurin aikin mai sabis ɗaya yayin da yake aiki ρ (rho) amfani: ɓangaren lokacin da masu sabis ke aiki, λ / (c μ) χ (chi) yawan fitarwa wato yawan tashi: fitarwar da aka lura, saboda kowane dalili α (alpha) yawan nasara: fitarwar da aka lura wadda ta zama daidai β (beta) yawan gazawa: fitarwar da aka lura wadda ta zama ba daidai ba δ (delta) yawan kammalawa: nasara + gazawa, abubuwan da aka yi musu sabis, ko sakamakon daidai ne ko kuskure σ (sigma) yawan tsallakewa: abubuwan da suka shiga, sannan suka fita ba tare da sabis ba ε (epsilon) rabon kuskure: β / (α + β) = β / δ τ (tau) lokaci a cikin tsarin wato lokacin jagora ω (omega) lokacin jira wato lokaci a cikin layi φ (phi) lokacin aiki wato lokaci a cikin na'urar sarrafawa wato lokacin sabis θ (theta) lokacin mataki tsakanin kammalawa; matsakaicin lokacin mataki ≈ 1 / χ a cikin daidaitaccen yanayi Ƙidaya Muna yawan ƙidaya abubuwa, kuma muna amfani da wannan alamar: κ (kappa): ƙidayar abubuwa a cikin tsarin, wato abubuwan da ke jira tare da abubuwan da ake aiki a kansu. Zane: abubuwa suna zuwa da yawan λ, akwai abubuwa κ a cikin tsarin, kuma abubuwa suna fita da fitarwa χ Misali: κ = 10 yana nufin daidai 10 κ ≈ 10 yana nufin kusan 10 κ 10 yana nufin fiye da 10 κ ≪ 10 yana nufin ƙasa da 10 sosai κ ≫ 10 yana nufin fiye da 10 sosai Ƙidaya κ (kappa) hoto ne na lokaci guda. Matsakaicin ƙidaya κ̅ (kappa mai layi) lissafi ne da ke ɗaukar matsakaicin ma'auni a tsawon wani lokaci na musamman, misali auna kowace awa har tsawon mako biyu. Yawan isowa, yawan sabis Alamomi mafi muhimmanci: λ (lambda): yawan isowa. Wannan yana auna saurin shigowar sababbin abubuwa cikin layi. μ (mu): yawan sabis wato ƙarfi. Wannan yana auna saurin da mai sabis ɗaya zai iya sarrafa abubuwa yayin da yake aiki. Misalan ƙa'idoji na gama-gari don layukan gargajiya masu mai sabis ɗaya: λ μ yana nufin yawan isowa ya fi yawan sabis; layin yana girma a kai a kai, da kusan abubuwa λ − μ a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Ra'ayin da ke zuwa a zuci cewa "λ = μ yana ajiye layin a girma ɗaya" gaskiya ne kawai idan isowa da sabis suna da cikakken tsari, kamar metronome. Isowa ta gaske tana zuwa gungu-gungu, don haka lokacin zaman banza da aka rasa a lokacin natsuwa ba za a taɓa dawo da shi ba, kuma layin yana girma a lokacin gungu na gaba. Ku sani cewa wasu masu aiki da ka'idar layi suna amfani da "yawan sabis" da ma'anar fitarwar da aka lura maimakon ƙarfi; duba bayyana ma'anar yawan sabis. Rabon amfani wato ƙarfin zirga-zirga Alamar da ta fi muhimmanci wadda ke taƙaita layi: ρ (rho): rabon amfani, wato ɓangaren lokacin da masu sabis ke aiki = λ / μ don mai sabis ɗaya, ko λ / (c μ) don masu sabis c Misalai: ρ 1 yana nufin isowa ta zarce ƙarfi; layin yana ƙara girma. Yawan fitarwa: jimillar yawa, yawan kammalawa, yawan nasara, yawan gazawa, yawan tsallakewa Yawan fitarwa yana auna fitarwar da aka lura, wato abubuwan da suka fita daga layi a zahiri. Suna zuwa cikin manyan rukunoni biyar: χ (chi): jimillar yawa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane lokaci ke fita daga layi saboda kowane dalili: nasara, gazawa, tsallakewa, da sauransu. α (alpha): yawan nasara. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane tsawon lokaci suka zama daidai misali sahihai, cikakku, karɓaɓɓu. β (beta): yawan gazawa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane tsawon lokaci suka zama ba daidai ba misali marasa inganci, marasa cikawa, waɗanda aka ƙi. δ (delta): yawan kammalawa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane tsawon lokaci ake yi musu sabis, ko sakamakon daidai ne ko kuskure: nasara + gazawa. σ (sigma): yawan tsallakewa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane tsawon lokaci ke shiga layi, sannan su fita ba tare da an yi musu sabis ba, misali barin layi, janyewa. Yawan kammalawa = yawan nasara + yawan gazawa: δ = α + β (ana furtawa: delta daidai da alpha da beta) Jimillar yawa = yawan kammalawa + yawan tsallakewa: χ = δ + σ (ana furtawa: chi daidai da delta da sigma) Jimillar yawa = yawan nasara + yawan gazawa + yawan tsallakewa: χ = α + β + σ (ana furtawa: chi daidai da alpha da beta da sigma) Zane: abubuwa suna fita daga tsarin a matsayin nasara α, gazawa β ko tsallakewa σ; waɗanda aka kammala δ = α + β, don haka χ = δ + σ Kowane abu da aka ƙidaya a cikin χ ya shiga tsarin, don haka a cikin daidaitaccen yanayi jimillar yawa daidai take da yawan isowa: χ ≈ λ. Shi ya sa yawan fitarwa ke auna fitarwa, ba ƙarfi ba. Bayyana ma'anar yawan sabis Dangane da mahallin da mai aiki, kalmar "yawan sabis" na iya nufin ko dai "jimillar yawa" ko "yawan nasara". Wannan yana da tushe a tarihi kuma yana iya haifar da ruɗani da kurakurai, musamman ga mahallai da masu aiki da ke amfani da ka'idar layi inda akwai babbar buƙatar bin diddigin gazawa da tsallakewa. Ra'ayin Ka'ida: Yawan sabis ma'auni ne zalla na sauri (misali, ayyuka a kowane daƙiƙa), ba tare da la'akari da ko ayyukan nasarori ne, gazawa, tsallakewa, da sauransu ba. Ra'ayin Sarrafawa: Yawan sabis ya haɗa da duk abin da layi ke kashe lokaci yana sarrafawa, wato nasarori ko gazawa, amma bai haɗa da tsallakewa ba. Ra'ayin Fasaha: A fannonin aiki kamar injiniyancin manhaja, yawan sabis yana auna nasarori ne kawai, yayin da yawan kuskure ke auna gazawa, kuma yawan tsallakewa ke auna tsallakewa. Saboda haka muna ajiye μ don ƙarfi, kuma muna ƙara yawan fitarwar da aka lura tare da ita, maimakon maye gurbinta: μ (mu): yawan sabis wato ƙarfi. Wannan yana auna saurin da mai sabis ɗaya zai iya sarrafa abubuwa yayin da yake aiki. χ (chi): jimillar yawa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane lokaci ke fita daga layi saboda kowane dalili: nasara, gazawa, tsallakewa, da sauransu. α (alpha): yawan nasara. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa a kowane tsawon lokaci suka zama daidai misali sahihai, cikakku, karɓaɓɓu. Me ya sa ba za a maye gurbin μ da χ ko α ba? A cikin layi mai kwanciyar hankali, kowane abu da ya shiga daga ƙarshe yana fita, don haka χ ≈ λ. Sannan λ / χ ≈ 1 ko yaya nauyin yake, wanda ba ya faɗin komai game da yawan aikin masu sabis. Amfani yana buƙatar ƙarfi: ρ = λ / (c μ), wanda ya yi daidai da ɓangaren lokacin da masu sabis ke aiki. Yawan tsallakewa Cikakkun bayanai game da yawan tsallakewa: σ (sigma): yawan tsallakewa. Wannan yana auna abubuwa nawa ke shiga layi, sannan su fita ba tare da an sarrafa su ba. Tsallakewa ita ce lokacin da wani abu ya shiga layi, sannan ya fita ba tare da wani muhimmin sarrafawa ba: Barin layi (abandoning): lokacin da abokin ciniki ya shiga layi, sannan ya fita, saboda kowane dalili. Janyewa (reneging): lokacin da abokin ciniki da ya riga ya jira ya yanke shawarar fita saboda ya ɓata lokaci mai yawa. Halaye biyu masu alaƙa ba tsallakewa ba ne: Ƙin shiga (balking): lokacin da abokin ciniki ya yanke shawarar kada ya shiga layi saboda lokacin jira yana barazanar yin tsayi da yawa. Abin da ya ƙi shiga bai taɓa shiga tsarin ba, don haka yana wajen iyakar tsarin: ba a ƙidaya shi a cikin λ, χ, ko σ. Idan ƙin shiga yana da muhimmanci, kamar tallace-tallacen da aka rasa, to ku ƙidaya su daban a matsayin isowar da aka mayar. Sauya layi (jockeying): lokacin da abokin ciniki ke sauyawa tsakanin layuka masu tafiya kafaɗa da kafaɗa, kamar layukan biyan kuɗi, yana ƙoƙarin samun jira mafi gajarta. Rabon kuskure Alamar da ta fi muhimmanci wadda ke taƙaita nasarar layi: ε (epsilon): rabon kuskure = ƙidayar gazawa / (ƙidayar nasara + ƙidayar gazawa) = β / (α + β) = β / δ An cire tsallakewa, domin ba a taɓa yi wa abin da aka tsallake sabis ba, don haka bai zama daidai ba kuma bai zama ba daidai ba. Ku bi diddigin tsallakewa daban ta hanyar σ. Zane: yawan kammalawa δ shi ne yawan nasara α da yawan gazawa β, kuma rabon kuskure ε shi ne yawan gazawa β a raba da yawan kammalawa δ Misalai: ε = 0 yana nufin babu kurakurai. ε = 0.1 yana nufin kashi 10% na sabis suna da kuskure. ε = 1 yana nufin kowane sabis yana da kuskure. Lokacin jagora, lokacin mataki, lokacin aiki, lokacin jira Muna bin diddigin lokuta huɗu: τ (tau): lokacin jagora = daga farkon layi zuwa ƙarshen layi θ (theta): lokacin mataki = daga kammalawa ɗaya zuwa kammalawa ta gaba; lokacin mataki ɗaya tazara ɗaya ce, kuma matsakaicin lokacin mataki shi ne matsakaicin tazara φ (phi): lokacin aiki = lokacin da aka kashe ana yin ainihin aiki wato lokacin sarrafawa ω (omega): lokacin jira = lokacin da aka kashe ba tare da yin ainihin aiki ba wato lokacin dakon Zane: lokacin jagora τ shi ne lokacin jira ω sai kuma lokacin aiki φ, don haka τ = ω + φ Misalai: τ = 5s yana nufin an ƙara wani abu cikin layi, sannan aka yi masa sabis daƙiƙa 5 bayan haka. ω = 4s yana nufin wani abu yana jira a cikin layi na daƙiƙa 4, sannan aiki ya fara. φ = 1s yana nufin wani abu yana ɗaukar daƙiƙa 1 na aiki, sannan ya kammala. θ = 1s yana nufin akwai daƙiƙa 1 tsakanin kammalawa ɗaya da kammalawa ta gaba. Dangantaka: τ = ω + φ: lokacin jagora shi ne lokacin jira tare da lokacin aiki. A cikin misalan, 5s = 4s + 1s. matsakaicin θ ≈ 1 / χ: a cikin daidaitaccen yanayi, matsakaicin lokacin mataki shi ne juyin jimillar yawa. Tazara ɗaya ba ta faɗin abu mai yawa game da yawan; matsakaicin tazara masu yawa kuwa yana faɗi. A cikin misalan, idan matsakaicin lokacin mataki 1s ne, to χ ≈ abu 1 a kowane daƙiƙa. Alamomin Kendall Alamomin Kendall wasu alamomi ne daban na ka'idar layi, waɗanda ake rubutawa kamar A/S/c/K/N/D: A: tsarin isowa, wato rarrabuwar lokaci tsakanin isowa. S: tsarin sabis, wato rarrabuwar lokutan sabis. c: adadin masu sabis. K: ƙarfin ɗauka, wato mafi yawan adadin abubuwan da aka yarda da su a cikin tsarin, masu jira ko waɗanda ake yi wa sabis, kafin a fara mayar da sababbin masu isowa. N: al'umma, wato adadin abokan ciniki masu yiwuwa. D: tsari (discipline), wato nau'in layi, kamar FIFO ko LIFO. Haruffan da aka saba amfani da su don A da S: M: Markovian wato marar ƙwaƙwalwa, wato lokuta masu bin rarrabuwar exponential, waɗanda ke tasowa daga isowar Poisson. D: Deterministic, wato lokuta marasa sauyawa. G: General (gama-gari), wato kowace irin rarrabuwa. Idan aka bar uku na ƙarshe, ƙimomin da aka saba su ne K = ∞, N = ∞, D = FIFO. Misali, "M/M/1" yana nufin isowar Poisson, lokutan sabis na exponential, mai sabis ɗaya, ƙarfin ɗauka marar iyaka, al'umma marar iyaka, kuma na farko da ya shigo shi ne na farko da zai fita. Kuma: n: adadin abubuwa a cikin tsarin.

records.title: Lissafin layi
records.text: Sassan lissafi suna amfani da alamomin littattafan karatu, don ku iya kwatanta su da wasu majiyoyi: S shi ne matsakaicin lokacin sabis, wanda shi ne φ ɗinmu, kuma μ = 1 / S shi ne ƙarfin mai sabis ɗaya. Lanƙwasan amfani Sakamako guda ɗaya mafi muhimmanci a ka'idar layi: yayin da amfani ke kusantar 100%, lokacin jira yana girma ba tare da iyaka ba, kuma yana girma mafi sauri a ƙarshe. Don layin M/M/1, inda S shi ne matsakaicin lokacin sabis: Lokacin jagora τ = S / (1 − ρ) Lokacin jira ω = S × ρ / (1 − ρ) Amfani ρ Lokacin jagora τ Lokacin jira ω 50% 2 × S 1 × S 70% 3.3 × S 2.3 × S 80% 5 × S 4 × S 90% 10 × S 9 × S 95% 20 × S 19 × S 99% 100 × S 99 × S Misali: bitar lamba (code review) tana ɗaukar awa 1 na aiki. Idan masu bita suna aiki kashi 80% na lokaci, bita tana ɗaukar kusan awa 5 daga buƙata zuwa kammalawa. Idan masu bita suna aiki kashi 95%, tana ɗaukar kusan awa 20, duk da cewa aikin masu bitar ya ƙaru da maki 15 na kashi kawai. Shi ya sa "a sa kowa ya yi aiki 100%" girke-girke ne na dogayen lokutan jagora, kuma shi ya sa fahimta da ke ƙasa ke gargaɗi game da tsara babban amfani. Dabarar Kingman Dabarar Kingman, wato ma'aunin VUT, tana kimanta lokacin jira ga layi mai mai sabis ɗaya tare da kowace irin rarrabuwar isowa da sabis (G/G/1): ω ≈ (ρ / (1 − ρ)) × ((ca² + cs²) / 2) × S Abubuwa uku na dabarar su ne: U: abin amfani ρ / (1 − ρ), wanda shi ne lanƙwasan amfani na sama. V: abin bambance-bambance (ca² + cs²) / 2, inda ca shi ne ma'aunin bambanci (coefficient of variation) na lokaci tsakanin isowa, kuma cs shi ne ma'aunin bambanci na lokutan sabis. Ma'aunin bambanci shi ne karkacewar ma'auni da aka raba da matsakaici. T: abin lokaci S, matsakaicin lokacin sabis. Misali: don layin M/M/1, ca = cs = 1, don haka V = 1, kuma dabarar tana ba da lokacin jira iri ɗaya da lanƙwasan amfani. Idan kuka sa abubuwan aiki su zama masu kama da juna sosai, kamar ta hanyar raba manyan tikiti ta yadda cs zai sauka daga 1 zuwa kusan 0, to V zai sauka zuwa kusan 0.5, kuma lokacin jira zai ragu kusan rabi a amfani iri ɗaya. Dabarar Kingman tana nuna hanyoyi uku na rage lokacin jira: Rage amfani, kamar ta hanyar ƙara ƙarfi ko iyakance aikin da ake yi a lokaci ɗaya. Rage bambance-bambance, kamar ta hanyar ƙananan rukunoni, abubuwan aiki masu kama da juna, ko isowa mai santsi. Rage lokacin sabis, kamar ta hanyar sarrafa kai (automation). Haɗa layi da Erlang C Layi ɗaya da aka raba wanda ke ciyar da masu sabis da yawa ya fi layuka daban-daban waɗanda kowannensu ke ciyar da mai sabis ɗaya. Shi ya sa bankuna ke amfani da layi ɗaya da ke ciyar da masu karɓar kuɗi da yawa, kuma shi ya sa layin tallafi da aka raba ya fi layi na kowane wakili. Misali: masu sabis biyu kowannensu yana ɗaukar awa 1 a kowane abu, kuma abubuwa suna isowa a abubuwa 1.6 a kowace awa gabaɗaya, don haka amfani shi ne 80%. Layuka daban-daban: kowane mai sabis layin M/M/1 ne mai isowa 0.8 a kowace awa, don haka lokacin jagora shi ne 1 / (1 − 0.8) = awa 5. Layin da aka haɗa: masu sabis biyun suna raba layin M/M/2, don haka lokacin jagora kusan awa 2.8 ne, wanda ya ragu da kusan 44%, da mutane iri ɗaya da aiki iri ɗaya. Dabarar Erlang C tana lissafin yiwuwar cewa abin da ya iso dole ne ya jira a cikin layin M/M/c, tare da nauyin da aka bayar a = λ / μ da amfani ρ = a / c: P(wait) = ((aᶜ / c!) / (1 − ρ)) / (Σₖ₌₀ᶜ⁻¹ (aᵏ / k!) + (aᶜ / c!) / (1 − ρ)) Lokacin jira ω = P(wait) / (c μ − λ) Ƙungiyoyin sabis na abokan ciniki suna amfani da Erlang C don yanke shawarar wakilai nawa za a sa a aiki don cimma wata manufa, kamar "a amsa kashi 80% na kira cikin daƙiƙa 20". Haɗa layi yana da iyaka: yana aiki mafi kyau idan kowane mai sabis zai iya sarrafa kowane abu. Idan abubuwa na buƙatar ƙwararru, to layin da aka haɗa na iya buƙatar ƙa'idojin tura abubuwa.

records.title: Bin diddigin ayyuka
records.text: Misalan ayyuka A ce muna da wani abu da muke so mu bi diddigi, kuma muna kiransa da wani suna na gama-gari kamar "Aiki" (Activity) kuma a gajarce "A". Za mu iya amfani da alamomin layi yadda ya kamata don bayyana aikin da yadda yake tafiya cikin layi. Misalai: Aκ: ƙidayar Aiki: abubuwa nawa ne a cikin layi. Aλ: yawan isowar Aiki: abubuwa nawa ke shigowa a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Aχ: jimillar yawan Aiki: abubuwa nawa ke fita daga layi a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Aα: yawan nasarar Aiki: abubuwa nawa ne daidai a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Aβ: yawan gazawar Aiki wato yawan kuskure: abubuwa nawa ne ba daidai ba a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Aμ: yawan sabis na Aiki wato ƙarfi: abubuwa nawa mai sabis ɗaya zai iya kammalawa a kowace raka'ar lokaci yayin da yake aiki. Aσ: yawan tsallakewar Aiki: abubuwa nawa ake barinsu a kowace raka'ar lokaci. Aρ: rabon amfanin Aiki: ɓangaren lokacin da ake da shi da masu sabis ke aiki, wato lokacin shagaltuwa ÷ lokacin da ake da shi, ko λ / (c μ). Aε: rabon kuskuren Aiki: abubuwa nawa aka kammala da kurakurai idan aka kwatanta da jimilla. Aτ: lokacin jagoran Aiki: lokaci nawa ke wucewa daga buƙata zuwa kammalawa. Aω: lokacin jiran Aiki: lokaci nawa ke wucewa daga buƙata zuwa farawa. Aφ: lokacin aikin Aiki: lokaci nawa ke wucewa daga farawa zuwa kammalawa. Aθ: lokacin matakin Aiki: lokaci nawa ke wucewa daga kammalawa zuwa kammalawa ta gaba. Dokar Little Dokar Little wata ka'ida ce (theorem) ta John Little wadda ta ce: matsakaicin adadin abokan ciniki na dogon lokaci L a cikin tsari mai tsayayye daidai yake da matsakaicin yawan isowa mai tasiri na dogon lokaci λ da aka ninka da matsakaicin lokaci W da abokin ciniki ke kashewa a cikin tsarin. Misalin alamomi: L: matsakaicin adadin abokan ciniki na dogon lokaci a cikin tsarin. Mun fi son κ (kappa). λ: matsakaicin yawan isowa mai tasiri na dogon lokaci, wato abubuwan da suka shiga tsarin a zahiri, don haka ban da ƙin shiga. W: matsakaicin lokaci na dogon lokaci da abu ke cikin tsarin. Mun fi son τ (tau). L = λ W ita ce dokar Little. Mun fi son κ = λ τ (kappa = lambda \ tau). Dokar Little gama-gari ce ƙwarai: tana aiki ba tare da la'akari da rarrabuwar isowa, rarrabuwar sabis, adadin masu sabis, ko nau'in layi ba. Zatonnin dokar Little: Duk raka'o'in auna sun yi daidai da juna. Tsarin yana da kwanciyar hankali, wato matsakaicin yawan isowa daidai yake da matsakaicin yawan tashi a tsawon lokacin auna, kuma adadin abubuwa kusan iri ɗaya ne a farko da a ƙarshe. Abubuwan da suka fita da wuri, kamar ta hanyar janyewa, ko dai a ƙidaya su daidai a cikin λ da τ duka biyun, ko a cire su daidai daga duka biyun. Misali: wata ƙungiya tana da matsakaicin κ = tikiti 20 da ake aiki a kansu, kuma tikiti suna isowa a λ = 4 a kowane mako; a cikin daidaitaccen yanayi, ƙungiyar kuma tana kammala χ = 4 a kowane mako. Don haka matsakaicin tikiti yana ɗaukar τ = κ / λ = makonni 5. Don rage lokacin jagora da rabi ba tare da yin aiki da sauri ba, ku rage aikin da ake yi a lokaci ɗaya da rabi. Manyan alamomin aiki (KPIs) Yawanci muna bin diddigin abubuwa da yawa game da ayyukan da ke cikin layi, kuma muna so mu taƙaita sakamakon ta hanyar zaɓar ɗan gajeren jerin waɗanda suka fi dacewa da ayyukanmu. Mun gina ayyuka da yawa, kuma mun yi imani cewa alamomin taƙaitawa mafi daraja su ne: Dτ = Lokacin jagoran isarwa (Delivery). Ƙungiyoyin samfura na iya cewa "daga ra'ayi zuwa abokin ciniki" ko "daga tunani zuwa aiwatarwa". Dα = Yawan nasarar isarwa. Ƙungiyoyin DevOps na iya cewa "yawan turawa" ko "muna fitar da manhaja sau X a kowace rana". Dε = Rabon kuskuren isarwa. Ƙungiyoyin inganci na iya cewa "yawan gazawar sauyi" ko "kashi na mayarwa baya (rollbacks)". Rτ = Lokacin jagoran maidowa (Restore). Injiniyoyin amincin shafi (site reliability engineers) na iya cewa "lokacin farfaɗowa daga turawar da ta gaza" ko "matsakaicin lokacin maidowa (MTTR)".

records.title: Ma'aunan sabis
headings: Matsakaicin lokacin amsawa, gyarawa, farfaɗowa, warwarewa
records.text: Kalmomi masu amfani: Service Level Indicator (SLI), Alamar Matakin Sabis: ita ce ma'aunin (misali, 99.9% na lokacin aiki) Service Level Objective (SLO), Manufar Matakin Sabis: manufar cikin gida don wannan ma'aunin (misali, nufin 99.95% na lokacin aiki) Service Level Agreement (SLA), Yarjejeniyar Matakin Sabis: alƙawarin hukuma na kwangila ga abokin ciniki (misali, 99.9% na lokacin aiki tare da hukunci idan ba a cimma ba). Matsakaicin lokacin amsawa, gyarawa, farfaɗowa, warwarewa MTTR tana wakiltar ma'auni huɗu daban-daban: Ma'auni Mayar da hankali Abin da yake auna Farawa Ƙarewa Matsakaicin Lokacin Amsawa (Mean Time To Respond) Martani na farko Lokacin sanin matsalar da fara ɗaukar mataki Lokacin da aka gano/aka ba da rahoton matsalar Lokacin da ƙungiya ta fara aiki a kanta Matsakaicin Lokacin Gyarawa (Mean Time To Repair) Gyaran fasaha Lokacin gyara abin da ya lalace Lokacin da aikin gyara ya fara Lokacin da aka gyara abin Matsakaicin Lokacin Farfaɗowa (Mean Time To Recover) Maido da sabis Lokacin maido da cikakken sabis Lokacin da matsala/katsewa ta fara Lokacin da sabis ke aiki gabaɗaya Matsakaicin Lokacin Warwarewa (Mean Time To Resolve) Cikakkiyar warwarewa Jimillar lokaci daga ganowa zuwa rufewa Lokacin da aka gano matsalar Lokacin da aka rufe matsalar gabaɗaya Muhimman bambance-bambance: Amsawa tana auna shirin ƙungiya da tasirin faɗakarwa. Ƙaramin lokacin amsawa yana nufin cewa sa idonku da hanyoyin aikin masu jiran kira (on-call) suna aiki da kyau, ko da ainihin gyaran yana ɗaukar tsawon lokaci. Gyarawa batu ne na fasaha kawai a taƙaice—tsawon wane lokaci ake ɗauka a zahiri don gyara abin da ya lalace da zarar kun fara aiki a kansa? Ba ta haɗa da lokacin ganowa, rarrabe fifiko (triage), da tabbatarwa ba. Farfaɗowa tana game da samuwar sabis daga mahangar abokin ciniki. Tsarin na iya kasancewa "an gyara shi" amma bai riga ya "farfaɗo" ba idan har yanzu kuna buƙatar maido da bayanai, dumama ma'ajiyar wucin gadi (caches), ko tabbatar da aiki. Warwarewa ita ce mafi cikakken ma'auni—tana ɗaukar dukan zagayen rayuwar matsalar daga ganowa ta farko har zuwa tabbatarwa bayan matsalar da rufewa. Misalin yanayi: 2:00 na dare — Katsewa ta fara 2:05 na dare — Faɗakarwa ta tashi, an gano matsalar 2:15 na dare — Mai jiran kira ya tabbatar da sani kuma ya fara aiki → Lokacin amsawa: minti 10 (2:05 zuwa 2:15) 2:45 na dare — An gano tushen matsalar, an tura gyara → Lokacin gyarawa: minti 30 (2:15 zuwa 2:45) 3:00 na dare — An tabbatar sabis yana aiki ga masu amfani → Lokacin farfaɗowa: minti 60 (2:00 zuwa 3:00) 3:30 na dare — An rufe tikitin matsalar bayan tabbatarwa → Lokacin warwarewa: minti 85 (2:05 zuwa 3:30) Ma'auni masu alaƙa: MTBF (matsakaicin lokaci kafin gazawa) MTTF (matsakaicin lokaci zuwa gazawa) MTTA (matsakaicin lokaci zuwa tabbatar da sani) Ma'aunan DORA Ma'aunan DevOps Research and Assessment (DORA) manyan alamomin aiki (KPIs) ne na ma'aunin masana'antu musamman ga ƙungiyoyin DevOps na injiniyancin manhaja. Duba dora.dev. DORA yanzu tana amfani da ma'auni biyar, a rukunoni biyu. Ma'aunan yawan fitarwa: Change Lead Time (Lokacin jagoran sauyi) - Lokacin aiwatarwa, gwadawa, da isar da lamba (code) don wani fasali (ana auna shi daga commit zuwa turawa a cikin production). Ku fayyace abin da kuke nufi da farawa da ƙarewa. Misali, wasu ƙungiyoyi suna son auna daga lokacin da mai haɓakawa ya fara aiki a kan tikiti, zuwa lokacin da mai haɓakawar ya tura aikin zuwa tsarin haɗawa na ci gaba (continuous integration); wannan hanya ta fi tasiri wajen auna yawan aikin mutum. Deployment Frequency (Yawan turawa) - Adadin turawa a cikin wani tsawon lokaci. Ku fayyace abin da kuke nufi da turawa da yadda kuke bin diddigin yawansa. Misali, wasu ƙungiyoyi suna yin turawa zuwa rundunar sabobin production kuma suna bin diddigin cikakken yaɗawar, yayin da wasu ƙungiyoyi ke yin turawa zuwa sabar gwajin karɓuwar mai amfani (UAT) guda ɗaya kuma suna bin diddigin lokacin da manajan aiki ya aika sanarwa ta imel ga masu amfani don su fara gwadawa. Failed Deployment Recovery Time (Lokacin farfaɗowa daga turawar da ta gaza) - Lokacin da ake ɗauka don farfaɗowa daga turawar da ta haifar da gazawa a cikin production. A da ana kiran wannan Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) ko Time to Restore Service. Ku fayyace abin da kuke nufi da farfaɗowa. Misali, wasu ƙungiyoyi suna ƙidaya farfaɗowa a matsayin cikakkiyar warwarewa, wato jimillar lokaci daga lokacin da aka gano matsala zuwa lokacin da aka rufe ta gabaɗaya; an fi bayyana wannan hanya da Mean Time To Resolve. Ma'aunan rashin kwanciyar hankali: Change Failure Rate (Yawan gazawar sauyi) - Kashi na turawa da ke haifar da gazawa a cikin production kuma suna buƙatar gyara nan take, kamar mayarwa baya (rollback) ko gyaran gaggawa (hotfix). Ku fayyace abin da kuke nufi da gazawa. Misali, wasu ƙungiyoyi kuma suna ƙidaya gazawa idan sun fara aiki a kan tikitin aiki sannan suka gane cewa tikitin ba shi da isassun bayanai don ci gaba, don haka ƙungiyar ta mayar da tikitin ga ƙungiyar fayyace bukatu (specification). Deployment Rework Rate (Yawan sake aikin turawa) - Kashi na turawa da ba a tsara su ba, kamar don gyara matsala a cikin production. Wannan shi ne turawar da ba a tsara ba da aka raba da jimillar turawa. DORA ta ƙara wannan ma'aunin a shekarar 2024. Rahotannin DORA na baya kuma sun tattauna Reliability (Aminci) a matsayin ma'aunin aikin gudanarwa: kimantawa mafi faɗi, sau da yawa ta yanayi (qualitative), ta daidaiton sabis, kamar samuwa, lokacin aiki, jinkiri (latency), daidaito, da manufofin matakin sabis. Aminci yana taimakawa wajen nuna cewa babban sauri ba ya zuwa a kan farashin ƙarfin tsarin.

records.title: Layin layuka
records.text: Ka'idar layi tana da sauƙin faɗaɗawa zuwa layin layuka, kamar tsari na babban mataki wanda ya ƙunshi matakai, ko zangoni, ko ƙofofi na ƙaramin mataki. Layin layuka na Double Diamond Misali, ku yi la'akari da samfurin tsarin ƙirƙira na "Double Diamond" (Lu'u-lu'u Biyu), wanda ke fayyace matakai huɗu: Ganowa (Discover): A fahimci matsalar maimakon kawai a yi zaton abin da take. Fayyacewa (Define): Da fahimta daga zangon ganowa, a fayyace ƙalubalen. Haɓakawa (Develop): A ba da amsoshi daban-daban ga matsalar da aka fayyace sarai. Isarwa (Deliver): A gwada mafita daban-daban a ƙaramin mataki sannan a inganta su. Ka'idar layi za ta iya wakiltar wannan a matsayin layin tsari ɗaya wanda ya ƙunshi layukan mataki huɗu: Yawan isowar tsarin shi ne yawan isowar mataki na 1. Yawan nasarar tsarin shi ne yawan nasarar mataki na 4. Ƙidayar kuskuren tsarin ita ce jimillar ƙidayar kurakuran matakan. Ƙidayar tsallakewar tsarin ita ce jimillar ƙidayar tsallakewar matakan. Lokacin jagoran tsarin shi ne jimillar lokutan jagoran matakan. Mafi girman yawan fitarwar tsarin shi ne yawan fitarwar mataki mafi jinkiri, wato maƙura (bottleneck). Layin layuka na mazurari A cikin aikinmu na zahiri, muna yawan amfani da kalmar "mazurari" (funnel) don bayyana a sassauƙe layin layuka da ke rage ƙidayar abubuwa a kowane mataki: Layin ɗaukar ma'aikata wanda ke amfani da matakin tuntuɓa, matakin hira, da matakin tayin aiki. Ga irin wannan layi, muna nufin ƙara yawan isowar mataki na 1 zuwa matuƙa, wato ƙara tuntuɓarmu, kamar ta hanyar tallace-tallace. Layin saye wanda ke amfani da matakin binciken abokin ciniki, matakin kwandon sayayya, da matakin biyan kuɗi. Ga irin wannan layi, muna nufin rage yawan tsallakewar mataki na 2 zuwa ƙarami, wato rage barin kwandon sayayya, kamar ta hanyar tunatarwa. Layin shirye-shirye wanda ke amfani da matakin haɗawa, matakin karɓuwar mai amfani, da matakin yaɗa zuwa production. Ga irin wannan layi, muna nufin rage yawan kuskuren matakin yaɗa zuwa production zuwa ƙarami, kamar ta hanyar telemetry na canary.

records.title: Fahimta
records.text: Fahimta bakwai game da ka'idar layi, daga Bob Wescott, marubucin "The Every Computer Performance Book" (duba kuma taƙaitawar Kottke): Yayin da cibiyar sabis ta fi jinkiri, haka ya kamata mafi girman amfanin da kuke tsarawa a lokacin ƙololuwar nauyi ya yi ƙasa. Yana da matuƙar wuya a yi amfani da kashi 15% na ƙarshe na kowane abu. Yayin da kuke kusa da gefe, haka farashin yin kuskure ke ƙaruwa. Ƙaruwar lokacin amsawa tana da iyaka bisa adadin waɗanda za su iya jira. Ku tuna cewa wannan matsakaici ne, ba mafi girma ba. Akwai tasirin musun ɗan adam a cikin cibiyoyin sabis masu yawa. Ku nuna ƙananan ingantawa ta hanya mafi kyau.
